subject: Exec retreat — final access codes, guest manifest & accommodation confirmation
messages:
From: Elise Turner <elise.turner@harborhotel.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Morgan Travel <ops@morgantravel.co>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Exec retreat — initial room block and access info

Hi Sean —

Thanks for confirming dates for the May 26-28 executive offsite. Attached is the initial room block summary and the on-site operations outline. Highlights: 
- Block: 42 rooms (10 suites, 32 king/double rooms) held until May 5 for guaranteed rate then released.
- Check-in: standard 3:00 PM; early arrivals can be accommodated with guaranteed key packet for 10 rooms at 1:00 PM on request.
- Keycards: we will pre-program a temporary access code and physical key packet for VIPs arriving before 3pm.
- Loading: service entrance available on the north side (dock 3); we can reserve a 45-min window on Tue 26th 08:00–09:00.

Attachments: room_block_summary.pdf (attachment), venue_ops_outline.pdf (attachment)

A few quick questions for your team to confirm:
1) Do you have a final guest manifest (names, arrival times, mobility needs)?
2) Any dietary restrictions we should pre-share with culinary?
3) Will you require reserved parking passes or a shuttle?

If you can send the guest manifest by EOD Thursday (May 14), we can prepare key packets and VIP amenities. Happy to hop on a 15-min call if that helps.

Best,
Elise Turner
Senior Events Manager
Harbor Hotel & Conference Center
elise.turner@harborhotel.com | (617) 555-0147
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elise Turner <elise.turner@harborhotel.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>, Morgan Travel <ops@morgantravel.co>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec retreat — initial room block and access info

Hi Elise —

Thanks for the quick summary — this is helpful. A few adjustments/asks from our side: 

1) Guest manifest: attaching a small template would be great — we have a mix of VIPs and staff who may arrive early. Can you confirm the maximum number of pre-programmed early key packets you can do (we might need up to 15)?
2) Accessibility: several attendees require ground-floor or elevator-adjacent rooms. Laura will share the names. Please mark those as priority.
3) Parking & shuttle: we will need 8 reserved parking passes for executives arriving separately and one 12-seat shuttle for the evening of May 26 (airport runs 17:30–19:00 & 22:00–23:00). Can you confirm shuttle vendor and cost estimate?
4) Billing: we will route incidental charges to individual cards, but rooming and AV go on our master account. Marissa will follow up with PO/contract.

If you can push a blank guest_manifest_template.csv, I will populate and return by May 14. Also, any door access codes or vendor credentials we should pre-share with AV?

Thanks —
Sean
Head of Partnerships (on site lead)
Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0192

Hi Elise / Sean —

Quick note on accessibility & dietary needs from the executive team:
- Mobility: Kevin Zhao and Priya Natarajan need elevator-adjacent rooms (wireless roll-in ramps not required, but minimal step).
- Visual: Markus Klein prefers a lower bedside lamp and a printed agenda in large-print.
- Dietary: Peter Alden (gluten-free), Ana Rivera (vegan + nut allergy), and two guests with Halal requirements. I've attached a dietary_matrix.xlsx with the attendee names mapped to restrictions.

Also: if you can mark the two ADA rooms near the main elevator as held until May 20, that would be ideal.

Hi Marissa / Sean / team —

Thanks for the manifest and access map — all set on our end. Confirmations below: 

1) Early key packets: we can pre-program 15 early key packets and have them ready at Front Desk in sealed envelopes labeled with guest names.
2) ADA rooms: two elevator-adjacent rooms held until May 22 per Laura's request.
3) Greeter schedule: we have staff assigned at 13:15 and 15:00 on Tue May 26 for your VIP flights (Tom, we will meet flights and escort to the VIP entrance).
4) Parking & shuttle: Morgan Travel confirmed 12-seat shuttle for May 26 evening windows; parking passes will be placed in the key packets.
5) Corporate billing & rate: REDWOOD_CORP_2026 is applied; master invoice will be sent to PO-98807 contact.
6) Access codes & vendor credentials: temporary vendor wifi (SSID: Harbor_Guest_Redwood; PW: Rw2026Guest!) and a one-time vendor door code: 8421. Please ensure AV vendor signs in at the loading dock (dock 3) and picks up their access badge.

Attached: exec_guest_manifest.csv (updated, attachment), site_access_map.pdf (attachment), venue_short_instructions.txt (attachment). Also: parking waiver DocuSign sent to all drivers (link in previous email).

If anything else pops up we can do a quick 10-min check-in Monday morning. Looking forward to hosting you all.

Best,
Elise Turner
